# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: packages
#| code-summary: "Load packages"
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
packages <- c("amt", "lubridate",
              "terra", "sf",
              "beepr", "tictoc",
              "leaflet", "tidyterra")
walk(packages, require, character.only = T)

```

# Import GPS tracking data

```{r}

pig_all_steps <- read_csv("data/pig_all_steps_covs_20261015.csv")

# Convert timezone after import (resets to GMT)
pig_all_steps <- pig_all_steps %>% 
  mutate(
    t1_  = with_tz(t1_, tzone = "Australia/Darwin"),
    t2_ = with_tz(t2_, tzone = "Australia/Darwin"), 
    hour = hour(t1_) + minute(t1_)/60 + second(t1_)/3600,
    hour_round = hour(t1_),
    month = month(t1_),
    season = case_when(month %in% c(11,12, 1, 2, 3, 4) ~ "wet",
                       month %in% seq(5,10) ~ "dry")
    )

```

## Crop to East Alligator region

```{r}

pig_all_steps <- pig_all_steps %>% filter(x1_ > -170000)
paste0("There are ", nrow(pig_all_steps), " pig locations from ", length(unique(pig_all_steps$name)), " individuals in the subset.")

```

## Create sf object of pig data

```{r}

# convert to an sf object (x1_/y1_ are in GDA94 / GA Lambert, EPSG:3112)
# and reproject to WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for leaflet
pig_all_steps_sf <- pig_all_steps %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x1_", "y1_"), crs = 3112) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

```

## Create a bounding box around the pig data to crop the shooting data and other layers by

```{r}

pig_aoi <- st_bbox(pig_all_steps_sf) %>% 
  st_as_sfc() %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 3112) %>% 
  st_buffer(dist = 2500) %>%
  st_bbox() %>% # the buffer creates curved corners so we need to get the bounding box of the buffered area
  st_as_sfc()

# save the bounding box as a shapefile
# pig_aoi %>% 
#   st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
#   st_write("mapping/pig_aoi_wgs84.geojson", driver = "GeoJSON", delete_dsn = TRUE)

```

# Import shooting data

```{r}

# Import shapefile of shooting locations using sf
shooting_locations <- st_read("mapping/pig_shooting_2026.shp")

st_crs(shooting_locations)

# Import shapefile of shooting locations using terra
# shooting_locations <- vect("mapping/pig_shooting_2026.shp")

```

## Plot the shooting locations

```{r}

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = pig_all_steps_sf, aes(colour = name), size = 0.1, alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = shooting_locations, colour = "red", size = 0.5) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

### Crop the shooting locations

```{r}

filtered_shooting_locations <- shooting_locations %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 3112) %>% 
  st_crop(pig_aoi)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = pig_all_steps_sf, aes(colour = name), size = 0.1, alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = filtered_shooting_locations, colour = "red", size = 0.5) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

min(filtered_shooting_locations$Date)
max(filtered_shooting_locations$Date)

```

# Overlap between shooting and pig GPS locations

### Ensure the timezones match

```{r}

# check the timezone of the pig GPS locations
tz(pig_all_steps_sf$t1_)

# Add a posixct time column to the shooting locations
filtered_shooting_locations <- filtered_shooting_locations %>% mutate(
  shoot_id = row_number(),
  shoot_time = as.POSIXct(Time, format = "%d-%b-%Y %H:%M:%S", tz = "Australia/Darwin")
)

# check the timezone of the shooting locations
tz(filtered_shooting_locations$shoot_time)

min(filtered_shooting_locations$shoot_time)
max(filtered_shooting_locations$shoot_time)

```

## Use leaflet to plot the data

```{r}
#| label: leaflet-map
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# convert to an sf object (x1_/y1_ are in GDA94 / GA Lambert, EPSG:3112)
# and reproject to WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for leaflet
pig_all_steps_sf <- pig_all_steps %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x1_", "y1_"), crs = 3112) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

pal <- colorFactor(viridisLite::viridis(n_distinct(pig_all_steps_sf$name), option = "H"),
                    domain = pig_all_steps_sf$name)

# addCircleMarkers() draws one SVG element per point, and there are ~246k of
# them, which locks up the browser (and the VS Code webview in particular).
# Thin the points for display and draw them with WebGL via leafgl instead.
pig_map_pts <- pig_all_steps_sf %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  slice(seq(1, n(), by = 1)) %>% # every ith fix per pig
  ungroup()

# Break each pig's track wherever the gap between fixes is longer than this,
# so the lines don't jump across periods with no data
max_gap_hours <- 3

pig_map_pts <- pig_map_pts %>%
  arrange(name, t1_) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  mutate(new_seg = is.na(lag(t1_)) |
           difftime(t1_, lag(t1_), units = "hours") > max_gap_hours,
         seg = cumsum(new_seg)) %>%
  ungroup()

# one line per pig per continuous run of fixes
pig_map_lines <- pig_map_pts %>%
  group_by(name, seg) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  summarise(do_union = FALSE, .groups = "drop") %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING")

# Data for the time slider, sorted by time. Coordinates are stored as integers
# (degrees * 1e5, ~1 m) and times as seconds since the first fix, which keeps
# the JSON embedded in the html much smaller
pig_levels <- sort(unique(pig_map_pts$name))
t0 <- min(pig_map_pts$t1_)
pig_time <- pig_map_pts %>% arrange(t1_)
pig_time_xy <- st_coordinates(pig_time)

# Shooting events for the time slider: each appears as a large red dot at its
# shoot_time and fades out over shoot_fade_hours
shoot_fade_hours <- 6
shoot_pts <- filtered_shooting_locations %>%
  filter(!is.na(shoot_time)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)
shoot_xy <- st_coordinates(shoot_pts)

pig_time_data <- list(
  lng = as.integer(round(pig_time_xy[, "X"] * 1e5)),
  lat = as.integer(round(pig_time_xy[, "Y"] * 1e5)),
  t = as.integer(round(as.numeric(difftime(pig_time$t1_, t0, units = "secs")))),
  pig = match(pig_time$name, pig_levels) - 1L,
  brk = as.integer(pig_time$new_seg),
  pigs = pig_levels,
  cols = pal(pig_levels),
  t0 = as.numeric(t0),
  step = 30 * 60, # slider step (s), matching the 30 min fix rate
  max_gap = max_gap_hours * 3600,
  shoot = list(
    lng = as.integer(round(shoot_xy[, "X"] * 1e5)),
    lat = as.integer(round(shoot_xy[, "Y"] * 1e5)),
    t = as.integer(round(as.numeric(difftime(shoot_pts$shoot_time, t0, units = "secs")))),
    fade = shoot_fade_hours * 3600
  )
)

# The time slider is a custom canvas layer (the leaftime package draws every
# feature as SVG, which has the same problem as addCircleMarkers). Each redraw
# only draws the fixes inside the current time window: the trail of each pig
# as a line plus small points, and its latest fix as a large point (only if
# that fix is within max_gap_hours of the slider time).
pig_time_js <- r"--[
function(el, x, d) {
  var map = this;
  var n = d.t.length, npig = d.pigs.length, STEP = d.step;
  var t = d.t, pig = d.pig, brk = d.brk;
  var lat = new Float64Array(n), lng = new Float64Array(n);
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { lat[i] = d.lat[i] / 1e5; lng[i] = d.lng[i] / 1e5; }
  // htmlwidgets unboxes length-1 vectors, so wrap the shooting columns back
  // into arrays in case there is only one shoot
  var sh = { lat: [].concat(d.shoot.lat), lng: [].concat(d.shoot.lng),
             t: [].concat(d.shoot.t), fade: d.shoot.fade };
  var tMax = Math.ceil(Math.max(t[n - 1], Math.max.apply(null, sh.t)) / STEP) * STEP;
  var state = { cur: 86400, win: 86400, timer: null };

  // first index with t >= v
  function lowerBound(v) {
    var a = 0, b = n;
    while (a < b) { var m = (a + b) >> 1; if (t[m] < v) a = m + 1; else b = m; }
    return a;
  }

  function fmt(s) {
    return new Date((d.t0 + s) * 1000).toLocaleString('en-AU', {
      timeZone: 'Australia/Darwin', day: '2-digit', month: 'short',
      year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false });
  }

  var TimeLayer = L.Layer.extend({
    onAdd: function(m) {
      this._canvas = L.DomUtil.create('canvas', 'leaflet-zoom-hide');
      this._canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      m.getPanes().overlayPane.appendChild(this._canvas);
      m.on('moveend resize', this._reset, this);
      this._reset();
    },
    onRemove: function(m) {
      L.DomUtil.remove(this._canvas);
      m.off('moveend resize', this._reset, this);
    },
    _reset: function() {
      var size = map.getSize(), r = window.devicePixelRatio || 1, c = this._canvas;
      L.DomUtil.setPosition(c, map.containerPointToLayerPoint([0, 0]));
      c.width = size.x * r; c.height = size.y * r;
      c.style.width = size.x + 'px'; c.style.height = size.y + 'px';
      this.redraw();
    },
    redraw: function() {
      var c = this._canvas, ctx = c.getContext('2d'), r = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      ctx.setTransform(r, 0, 0, r, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, c.width / r, c.height / r);

      var lo = lowerBound(state.cur - state.win), hi = lowerBound(state.cur + 1);
      var px = new Float32Array(hi - lo), py = new Float32Array(hi - lo);
      var byPig = [], i, j, k, q, idx;
      for (k = 0; k < npig; k++) byPig.push([]);
      for (i = lo; i < hi; i++) {
        var p = map.latLngToContainerPoint([lat[i], lng[i]]);
        px[i - lo] = p.x; py[i - lo] = p.y;
        byPig[pig[i]].push(i);
      }

      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      for (k = 0; k < npig; k++) {
        idx = byPig[k];
        if (!idx.length) continue;
        ctx.strokeStyle = d.cols[k]; ctx.fillStyle = d.cols[k];
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (j = 0; j < idx.length; j++) {
          q = idx[j] - lo;
          if (j === 0 || brk[idx[j]]) ctx.moveTo(px[q], py[q]); else ctx.lineTo(px[q], py[q]);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (j = 0; j < idx.length; j++) {
          q = idx[j] - lo;
          ctx.moveTo(px[q] + 2.5, py[q]); ctx.arc(px[q], py[q], 2.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        }
        ctx.fill();
      }

      ctx.globalAlpha = 1; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      for (k = 0; k < npig; k++) {
        idx = byPig[k];
        if (!idx.length) continue;
        i = idx[idx.length - 1];
        if (state.cur - t[i] > d.max_gap) continue;
        q = i - lo;
        ctx.fillStyle = d.cols[k];
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px[q], py[q], 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      }

      // shooting events: full opacity at shoot_time, fading linearly to zero
      // over sh.fade seconds
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e60000';
      for (i = 0; i < sh.t.length; i++) {
        var age = state.cur - sh.t[i];
        if (age < 0 || age > sh.fade) continue;
        var s = map.latLngToContainerPoint([sh.lat[i] / 1e5, sh.lng[i] / 1e5]);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - age / sh.fade;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 10, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  });

  var layer = new TimeLayer().addTo(map);

  var ctrl = L.control({ position: 'bottomleft' });
  ctrl.onAdd = function() {
    var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
    div.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;padding:6px 10px;font:12px/1.5 sans-serif;';
    div.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">' +
        '<button type="button" class="pt-play" style="width:30px">&#9654;</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="pt-back" title="Back 30 min">&#8249;</button>' +
        '<div style="width:420px">' +
          '<input type="range" class="pt-slider" min="0" max="' + tMax + '" step="' + STEP +
            '" value="' + state.cur + '" style="width:100%;margin:0;display:block">' +
          // strip of shooting ticks under the slider; the side margins
          // roughly match the inset of the slider thumb's travel
          '<div class="pt-shoots" title="Click to jump to the nearest shooting event"' +
            ' style="position:relative;height:9px;margin:1px 8px 0;cursor:pointer"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<button type="button" class="pt-fwd" title="Forward 30 min">&#8250;</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:4px">' +
        '<span class="pt-label" style="min-width:290px"></span>' +
        'Trail <select class="pt-win">' +
          '<option value="21600">6 hours</option>' +
          '<option value="86400" selected>1 day</option>' +
          '<option value="259200">3 days</option>' +
          '<option value="604800">1 week</option>' +
          '<option value="2592000">30 days</option>' +
          '<option value="Infinity">All to date</option>' +
        '</select>' +
        'Speed <select class="pt-speed">' +
          '<option value="1800">30 min/s</option>' +
          '<option value="3600">1 hour/s</option>' +
          '<option value="10800">3 hours/s</option>' +
          '<option value="21600">6 hours/s</option>' +
          '<option value="43200">12 hours/s</option>' +
          '<option value="86400" selected>1 day/s</option>' +
          '<option value="259200">3 days/s</option>' +
          '<option value="604800">1 week/s</option>' +
        '</select>' +
      '</div>';
    L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
    L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
    return div;
  };
  ctrl.addTo(map);

  var div = ctrl.getContainer();
  var slider = div.querySelector('.pt-slider'), label = div.querySelector('.pt-label');
  var playBtn = div.querySelector('.pt-play'), win = div.querySelector('.pt-win');
  var speed = div.querySelector('.pt-speed');

  function update() {
    slider.value = state.cur;
    label.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.cur - state.win)) + '  –  ' + fmt(state.cur);
    layer.redraw();
  }
  function stop() {
    clearInterval(state.timer); state.timer = null; playBtn.innerHTML = '&#9654;';
  }

  // Playback speed is in seconds of data per real second. Each tick advances a
  // whole number of slider steps, with at most 10 ticks per second, so slow
  // speeds tick less often rather than moving by part of a step
  function start() {
    var rate = Number(speed.value);
    var k = Math.max(1, Math.round(rate / 10 / STEP));
    state.timer = setInterval(function() {
      state.cur = Math.min(state.cur + k * STEP, tMax);
      update();
      if (state.cur >= tMax) stop();
    }, 1000 * k * STEP / rate);
  }
  function stepBy(nSteps) {
    state.cur = Math.min(Math.max(state.cur + nSteps * STEP, 0), tMax);
    update();
  }

  // One red tick per slider step that has a shooting event in it. Clicking
  // the strip jumps to the nearest event, rounded up to the slider step so
  // the shooting dot is drawn at full opacity
  var shootBar = div.querySelector('.pt-shoots');
  var shootSteps = sh.t.map(function(s) {
    return Math.min(Math.max(Math.ceil(s / STEP) * STEP, 0), tMax);
  }).filter(function(s, i, a) { return a.indexOf(s) === i; })
    .sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
  shootSteps.forEach(function(s) {
    var tick = document.createElement('div');
    tick.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:0;width:2px;height:9px;margin-left:-1px;' +
      'background:#e60000;pointer-events:none;left:' + (100 * s / tMax) + '%';
    shootBar.appendChild(tick);
  });
  shootBar.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!shootSteps.length) return;
    var box = shootBar.getBoundingClientRect();
    var tClick = (e.clientX - box.left) / box.width * tMax;
    var best = shootSteps[0];
    shootSteps.forEach(function(s) {
      if (Math.abs(s - tClick) < Math.abs(best - tClick)) best = s;
    });
    stop();
    state.cur = best;
    update();
  });

  slider.addEventListener('input', function() { state.cur = +slider.value; update(); });
  win.addEventListener('change', function() { state.win = Number(win.value); update(); });
  speed.addEventListener('change', function() {
    if (state.timer) { clearInterval(state.timer); start(); }
  });
  div.querySelector('.pt-back').addEventListener('click', function() { stepBy(-1); });
  div.querySelector('.pt-fwd').addEventListener('click', function() { stepBy(1); });
  playBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (state.timer) { stop(); return; }
    if (state.cur >= tMax) state.cur = 0;
    playBtn.innerHTML = '&#10074;&#10074;';
    start();
  });

  update();
}
]--"

pig_map <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>%
  leafgl::addGlPolylines(data = pig_map_lines,
                         color = pal(pig_map_lines$name),
                         opacity = 0.6,
                         weight = 1.5,
                         group = "All tracks") %>%
  leafgl::addGlPoints(data = pig_map_pts,
                      fillColor = pal(pig_map_pts$name),
                      fillOpacity = 0.75,
                      radius = 5,
                      popup = paste0("ID: ", pig_map_pts$name,
                                     "<br>Time: ", pig_map_pts$t1_),
                      group = "All fixes") %>%
  addLegend(position = "bottomright", pal = pal,
            values = pig_map_pts$name, title = "Pig ID") %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft",
              options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE)) %>%
  addLegend(position = "bottomright", colors = "#e60000",
            labels = paste0("Shooting (fades over ", shoot_fade_hours, " h)")) %>%
  # the full tracks and fixes are off by default so the time slider layer is
  # readable; tick them on in the layers control
  addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("All tracks", "All fixes"),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  hideGroup(c("All tracks", "All fixes")) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender(pig_time_js, data = pig_time_data)

# The VS Code htmlwidget viewer struggles with large maps, so when working
# interactively write the map out and open it in the system browser. When the
# document is rendered, the widget is printed inline as usual.
if (interactive()) {
  map_file <- file.path("outputs", "pig_map.html") #tempdir()
  # selfcontained = FALSE writes a sibling _files/ folder, which avoids needing
  # pandoc on the path and is much faster to write for a map this size
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(pig_map, map_file, selfcontained = TRUE)
  utils::browseURL(map_file)
} else {
  pig_map
}

```

## Summaries of shooting

### Locations through time

```{r}

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = filtered_shooting_locations, aes(colour = shoot_time), size = 0.5) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```

### Hours of shooting

```{r}

filtered_shooting_locations <- filtered_shooting_locations %>% 
  mutate(
    shoot_hms = lubridate::hour(shoot_time) + lubridate::minute(shoot_time)/60 + lubridate::second(shoot_time)/3600
  ) 

filtered_shooting_locations %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = shoot_hms), bins = 30, fill = "red", colour = "black") +
  scale_x_datetime("Shooting time") +
```


### Check the CRS

```{r}

# Check CRS
st_crs(pig_all_steps_sf)
st_crs(filtered_shooting_locations)

# Update pig GPS locations to match the CRS of the shooting locations
pig_all_steps_sf <- st_transform(pig_all_steps_sf, st_crs(filtered_shooting_locations))
st_crs(pig_all_steps_sf)

```

## Distance in time and space of pig GPS locations to shooting events

```{r}

# Find all pig/shooting pairs within 5 km (returns a list of indices)
idx <- st_is_within_distance(pig_all_steps_sf, filtered_shooting_locations, dist = 2500)

# Turn that into a table of matched pairs
pairs <- tibble(
  pig_row   = rep(seq_along(idx), lengths(idx)),
  shoot_row = unlist(idx)
)

# Distance between each matched pair, in metres
pairs$dist_m <- as.numeric(
  st_distance(pig_all_steps_sf[pairs$pig_row, ],
              filtered_shooting_locations[pairs$shoot_row, ],
              by_element = TRUE)
)

# Attach the attributes from both objects
hits <- bind_cols(
  pig_all_steps_sf[pairs$pig_row, ],
  filtered_shooting_locations[pairs$shoot_row, ] %>% st_drop_geometry(), #%>% rename_with(~ paste0("shoot_", .x)),
  dist_m = pairs$dist_m
)

hits <- hits %>% 
  filter(t1_ >= shoot_time - hours(3),
         t1_ <= shoot_time + hours(3)) %>% 
  mutate(
    shoot_time_diff = as.numeric(difftime(t1_, shoot_time, units = "hours")),
  ) 

```

### Keep the nearest in time

For each shoot and each pig, take the pig GPS location that is nearest in time to the shooting event.

```{r}
  
hits_nearest_time <- hits %>% 
  group_by(name, shoot_id) %>% 
  slice_min(abs(shoot_time_diff), n = 1)  %>% 
  ungroup()

hits_nearest_time

```

### Extract pig GPS locations either side of the focal shoot location

```{r}

shoot_focal_window <- 12 # time either side of focal shooting location (in hours)

# One row per focal pig/shooting event, with the temporal window
focal <- hits_nearest_time %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(name, shoot_id, shoot_time) %>%
  mutate(win_start = shoot_time - hours(shoot_focal_window),
         win_end   = shoot_time + hours(shoot_focal_window))

# Shooting locations, same CRS as the pigs, one row per shoot_id
shoot_geom <- filtered_shooting_locations %>%
  select(shoot_id)

# Pull every GPS fix for that pig inside the window
seqs <- pig_all_steps_sf %>% 
  inner_join(focal,
             by = join_by(name, between(t1_, win_start, win_end)),
             relationship = "many-to-many")

# Distance (m) from each fix to its own focal shooting location
seqs <- seqs %>%
  mutate(
    dist_to_shoot_m = as.numeric(
      st_distance(geometry,
                  shoot_geom$geometry[match(shoot_id, shoot_geom$shoot_id)],
                  by_element = TRUE)),
    time_diff_hrs = as.numeric(difftime(t1_, shoot_time, units = "hours")),
    period = if_else(time_diff_hrs < 0, "baseline", "response"),
    seq_id = paste(name, shoot_id, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  arrange(seq_id, t1_)

seqs
```

# Look at the responses of a single individual

- keep only the relevant shoots for each pig
- put a few days on top of each other? shoot vs no shoot

```{r}

pig_ids <- unique(pig_all_steps_sf$name)

# to cover all tracking data
shooting_window_min <- min(pig_all_steps_sf$t1_)
shooting_window_max <- max(pig_all_steps_sf$t1_)

# to cover the extent of shooting
# shooting_window_min <- min(filtered_shooting_locations$shoot_time) - lubridate::days(3)
# shooting_window_max <- max(filtered_shooting_locations$shoot_time) + lubridate::days(3)

# to cover a specific period
# shooting_window_min <- lubridate::as_date("2025 11 01")
# shooting_window_max <- lubridate::as_date("2025 11 14")

for(i in 1:length(pig_ids)) {

  plot <- pig_all_steps_sf %>% filter(name == pig_ids[i] & 
                                        t1_ > shooting_window_min &
                                        t1_ < shooting_window_max
                                      ) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = t1_, y = sl_)) +
    
    geom_vline(data = filtered_shooting_locations %>% 
                 filter(shoot_time > shooting_window_min & 
                          shoot_time < shooting_window_max), 
               aes(xintercept = shoot_time), 
               colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    
    
    geom_vline(data = filtered_shooting_locations %>%
                 filter(shoot_time > shooting_window_min &
                          shoot_time < shooting_window_max),
               aes(xintercept = shoot_time - lubridate::days(3)),
               colour = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +


    geom_vline(data = filtered_shooting_locations %>%
                 filter(shoot_time > shooting_window_min &
                          shoot_time < shooting_window_max),
               aes(xintercept = shoot_time + lubridate::days(3)),
               colour = "purple", linetype = "dashed") +
    
    geom_path() +
    labs(title = paste0(pig_ids[i]),
         x = "Time",
         y = "Step length (m)") +
    theme_bw()
  
  print(plot)
  
}

```

## Create a pseudo set of responses

Want want to use a null model for comparison. For this, we will take shooting incidences that are 3 days before the actual shooting events 

```{r}

pseudo_interval <- lubridate::days(3)

# One row per focal pig/shooting event, with the temporal window
focal_pseudo <- hits_nearest_time %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(name, shoot_id, shoot_time) %>%
  mutate(
    shoot_time = shoot_time - pseudo_interval,
    win_start = shoot_time - hours(shoot_focal_window),
    win_end   = shoot_time + hours(shoot_focal_window)
    )

# Shooting locations, same CRS as the pigs, one row per shoot_id
shoot_geom <- filtered_shooting_locations %>%
  select(shoot_id)

# Pull every GPS fix for that pig inside the window
seqs_pseudo <- pig_all_steps_sf %>% 
  inner_join(focal_pseudo,
             by = join_by(name, between(t1_, win_start, win_end)),
             relationship = "many-to-many")

# Distance (m) from each fix to its own focal shooting location
seqs_pseudo <- seqs_pseudo %>%
  mutate(
    dist_to_shoot_m = as.numeric(
      st_distance(geometry,
                  shoot_geom$geometry[match(shoot_id, shoot_geom$shoot_id)],
                  by_element = TRUE)),
    time_diff_hrs = as.numeric(difftime(t1_, shoot_time, units = "hours")),
    period = if_else(time_diff_hrs < 0, "baseline", "response"),
    seq_id = paste(name, shoot_id, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  arrange(seq_id, t1_)

seqs_pseudo

```

### Only the first shooting operation

```{r}

# first shooting operation
shooting_window_min <- lubridate::as_date("2025 11 01")
shooting_window_max <- lubridate::as_date("2025 11 10")

# shooting_window_min <- lubridate::as_date("2025 11 25")
# shooting_window_max <- lubridate::as_date("2025 12 14")

bin_means_both <- seqs_daily_both %>%
  filter(shoot_time > shooting_window_min & shoot_time < shooting_window_max) %>%
  mutate(bin = floor(time_diff_hrs / bin_width) * bin_width + bin_width / 2) %>%
  group_by(type, bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sl = mean(sl_, na.rm = TRUE),
    se      = sd(sl_, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(sl_))),
    q25     = quantile(sl_, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50     = quantile(sl_, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75     = quantile(sl_, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    n       = sum(!is.na(sl_)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

seqs_daily_both %>%
  filter(shoot_time > shooting_window_min & shoot_time < shooting_window_max) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_diff_hrs, y = sl_, colour = type, group = interaction(type, seq_id))) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.1) +

  # interquartile range as a ribbon
  geom_ribbon(data = bin_means_both, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = bin, ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = type, group = type),
              alpha = 0.25, colour = alpha("black", 0.75), linewidth = 0.15) +

  # median
  geom_line(data = bin_means_both, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = bin, y = q50, colour = type)) +
  geom_point(data = bin_means_both, inherit.aes = FALSE,
             aes(x = bin, y = q50, colour = type), size = 2) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous("Step length (m)") +

                     breaks = seq(-shoot_focal_window, shoot_focal_window, by = 3)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 500)) +
```

```{r}
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("outputs/step_length_shooting_vs_pseudo_both.png",
       width = 150, height = 100, units = "mm", scale = 1, dpi = 600)
```
